keyMappings:
# clear defaults
unmapAll

# navigation on page
map k scrollUp
map j scrollDown
map h scrollLeft
map l scrollRight
map <c-b> scrollFullPageUp
map <c-f> scrollFullPageDown
map <c-u> scrollPageUp
map <c-d> scrollPageDown
map G scrollToBottom
map gg scrollToTop

# navigation in history
map .. goBack

# tabs operations
map u previousTab
map o nextTab
map U moveTabLeft
map O moveTabRight
map t createTab
map d duplicateTab
map w removeTab
map Wu closeTabsOnLeft
map Wo closeTabsOnRight
map r reload
map ] zoomIn
map [ zoomOut

# search
map f LinkHints.activateMode
map / enterFindMode
map n performFind
map N performBackwardsFind
